spanish: Y tomó Aarón a Elisheva hija de Aminadav, hermana de Najshón, a él a mujer, y dio a luz a él a Nadav y a Avihú, a Eleazar y a Itamar.

findings.issue: Qal 3fs וַתֵּלֶד requires a feminine subject (Elisheva); Spanish leaves Aarón as the continuing subject of "dio a luz", shifting person/participant.

notes: לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה and the four sons are otherwise covered; mark the birth-subject (e.g. ella) to match 3fs.
